top_signals.title: Iran Believes It Has the 'Upper Hand': CSIS's Yacoubian
top_signals.summary: CSIS Director and Senior Adviser Mona Yacoubian argues the Trump administration has failed to carry out some of its maximalist threats against the Iranian regime, causing the regime to believe it has the upper hand in the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
